description: Hold specific seats of an on-sale event for a short time, all or none. Returns a hold_group_id, the seats, the total and when the hold expires; give the hold_group_id to the person you are helping, who finishes the reservation themselves. Calling again with the same idempotency_key and seats returns the same result, and a retry after a timeout is safe.

event_seat_ids.description: The event_seat_id values to hold, from check_availability, 1 to 8 of them

idempotency_key.description: A fresh key you choose for this request, such as a UUID; reuse it only to retry the same request

name: hold_seats
